name: BLOOD BANK REFRIGERATOR
desc: Premium Blood Bank Refrigerator engineered for the precise and safe storage of whole blood and blood components within a strict 2°C to 6°C range. Built with a 150-liter capacity accommodating up to 64 blood bags, featuring dual-door configuration and built-in temperature chart recorder.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS BLOOD BANK REFRIGERATOR is engineered for precise cold-chain preservation of whole blood and blood components, maintaining a stable 2°C to 6°C climate with ±1°C uniformity. Its microprocessor-based PID controller continuously interprets signals from a high-sensitivity industrial PT-100 sensor and modulates the hermetically sealed Emerson/Tecumseh compressor charged with CFC-free R134a refrigerant. A dynamically balanced forced-air blower system distributes conditioned air across the 150-liter SS 304 chamber, while high-density PUF insulation and dual-door design minimize thermal exchange. This system supports doctors, transfusion medicine specialists, B.Sc/M.Sc biomedical and clinical laboratory students, and PhD researchers in storing CPDA-1 anticoagulated whole blood, SAGM-additive red cell concentrates, platelet-rich plasma, and cryoprecipitate under AABB, WHO blood cold chain, ISO 13485, and ASTM E2877 compliant conditions, preventing hemolysis, bacterial proliferation, and coagulation factor degradation.
sop: Place the unit on a level, vibration-free surface away from direct sunlight and heat sources, and connect to a 220/240 V, 50 Hz grounded outlet.
Switch ON the main power supply and allow the compressor to run empty for 30 minutes to stabilize internal air circulation.
Press the 'SET' button once on the PID controller to enter temperature setpoint mode.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter of 4°C (or within 2°C to 6°C as per blood component protocol).
Press 'SET' again to lock the value and allow the controller to auto-tune the cooling cycle.
Verify the PT-100 sensor reading on the digital display stabilizes at 4°C ±1°C before loading any blood bags.
Open the outer insulated door and inner toughened glass door only when necessary, then load blood bags into the stainless steel roll-out drawers without blocking air vents.
Close both doors firmly and confirm the magnetic gasket seals; the automated door-open audio alert should silence.
Activate the in-built temperature chart recorder and insert a USB pen drive into the data logger port to begin continuous temperature auditing.
Monitor the display and chart recorder every 4 hours; if the sudden temperature change alarm sounds, immediately quarantine blood components and investigate power or compressor failure.

For daily cleaning, disconnect power, remove blood bags to a validated backup refrigerator, and wipe interior SS 304 surfaces with 70% isopropanol or a non-corrosive disinfectant; never use strong acids, alkalis, or abrasive pads.

Safety Warning: Never store volatile chemicals, food, or non-blood biological specimens in this unit; always keep the door closed during power interruptions and verify backup power/UPS before relying on the refrigerator for critical blood inventory.
